baseline_models.focus_anchor: The poor migrants are identified as those made to leave both their homes and their wealth.
baseline_models.mechanism: Poverty is narrated as a caused condition rather than an essence: forced outward removal severs residence and accumulated means, while the active migrant designation preserves agency within imposed loss.

activation_trace.role: Need and scant means name the resulting condition rather than an inherent identity.
Movement from one abode to another supplies the migrants' active trajectory.
Passively caused movement outside supplies the coercive break within that trajectory.
Residence and belonging to a home identify the place relation from which they were removed.
Possession and accumulation identify the material base removed with the dwelling.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing class of poor people who also happened to migrate.
changed_reading.after: People made poor through coerced loss of place and property, yet still named through their active migration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: After home and wealth are lost, their continuing activity is to seek divine favor and abundant acceptance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispossession does not extinguish desire; it redirects pursuit away from simple repossession toward a double object: favor as excess gift and رضوان as abundant or sought acceptance.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate seeking supplies the forward motion that follows forced loss.
Favor as freely given beneficence makes the first object more than repayment for confiscated assets.
Abundant or sought رضا supplies the second object and gives the pursuit an affective-moral horizon.

changed_reading.before: They endure material loss in hope of a generic reward.
changed_reading.after: Their loss opens a directed double pursuit of gift and abundant acceptance, neither reducible to recovering former assets.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of seeking and aiding culminates in the demonstrative verdict that these are the truthful.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth is made performative: assistance that manifests the divine-messenger cause and sustained pursuit under cost realize truth as fulfilled action rather than merely correct speech.

activation_trace.role: Aid and making manifest supply the public action on which the verdict rests.
Messenger and message specify the humanly mediated cause their aid serves.
Fulfillment in deed turns the closing truth label into an assessment of performed commitment.

changed_reading.before: The closing label offers a general commendation of sincere belief.
changed_reading.after: The closing label certifies alignment among costly movement, directed pursuit, and concrete aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding allocation frame treats recovered property as wealth that must not keep changing hands inside the rich stratum. The focus's opening dative therefore recasts caused poverty as a claim within an anti-concentration order; seeking divine favor does not cancel a material entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Material need identifies the people to whom the allocation turns.
Lost accumulated property explains why this need is a distributive claim rather than abstract pity.
The branch's recovered-property category supplies the concrete pool being allocated.
Transfer among hands supplies the circulation mechanism that the verse explicitly restricts.
Wealth and self-sufficiency identify the stratum in which circulation must not close.

structural_cues: The anti-concentration purpose in 59:7 immediately precedes the focus's initial dative construction.
The focus explains poverty by the paired loss of homes and wealth rather than by an unexplained status.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, recovered-property vocabulary, and a ban on rich-only circulation; I infer that the opening dative in 59:8 continues or specifies that allocation logic. A live alternative treats 59:8 as an independent commendation with looser syntactic attachment.

changed_reading.before: The migrants are needy beneficiaries selected out of compassion.
changed_reading.after: Their coerced dispossession gives them a concrete claim in a redistribution designed to break closed circulation among the wealthy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following group has made an abode, receives the migrant relation, prefers others despite its own breach of means, and resists acquisitive withholding. Migration is thus not permanent homelessness or solitary heroism; it is completed by a host community that converts settled place into shared belonging under real scarcity.

activation_trace.role: Departure from one abode leaves an open relational need for arrival and reception.
Lost residence supplies the belonging that the next social configuration must remake.
Taking an abode supplies the stable receiving side of the migration relation.
The repeated migration root explicitly makes the displaced person the object of the settled group's welcome.
Choosing the other over oneself supplies the transfer by which reception becomes material.
A breach in one's own means prevents the hosts' preference from being reduced to effortless surplus giving.
Withholding joined to acquisitive desire names the obstacle that must be overcome for rehoming to work.

structural_cues: The paired group openings in 59:8 and 59:9 place displaced and settled believers in adjacent complementary descriptions.
The migration root recurs in 59:9 as the object of the settled group's attachment and preference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent group descriptions, abode, repeated migration, preference, and scarcity; I infer a complementary rehoming mechanism in which the second group answers the first group's loss. A live alternative reads 59:9 as parallel praise without making reception the completion of migration.

changed_reading.before: Migration leaves the truthful poor as permanently uprooted individuals.
changed_reading.after: Their uprooting becomes one half of a reciprocal social process: costly departure is answered by costly reception, creating belonging without denying scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speakers promise the exact paired performances visible in the focus: departure when others are expelled and aid when they are fought. Their promised departure and aid fail, and they are called liars. This mirrored negative case calibrates the focus's truth verdict as reliable action under precisely those tests.

activation_trace.role: Actual forced exit supplies the first costly condition borne by the focus group.
Actual aid supplies the second performed commitment of the focus group.
Fulfillment in action makes the truth label answer the two performed commitments.
Promised outward departure mirrors the focus group's experienced exit but remains verbal.
Promised aid mirrors the focus group's enacted aid and creates the second test.
The explicit contrary of truth classifies the speakers whose paired promises will fail.
Negated departure exposes the failure of the first mirrored promise.
Repeated failed and unavailable aid exposes the failure of the second mirrored promise.

structural_cues: The expulsion/departure and aid pair from 59:8 is reproduced together in the conditional promises of 59:11.
The focus's closing truthful label is answered by the liar label in 59:11 and by explicit negations in 59:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exit and aid roots plus the opposed truth/lie verdicts; I infer that the later failed pair specifies the behavioral tests behind the focus's label. A live alternative keeps the label as broader moral truthfulness rather than tying it tightly to these two acts.

changed_reading.before: The truthful label is a broad statement about inward sincerity.
changed_reading.after: Truth is publicly testable correspondence between declared allegiance and actual departure-and-aid when those commitments become costly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus group is spatially severed and materially stripped yet grammatically coordinated in shared seeking and aid. The later adversarial group is repeatedly presented as gathered and fortified while its inner cores are dispersed. Place and enclosure therefore cease to be sufficient grounds of collective integrity; aligned action supplies a stronger cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Lost residence removes the usual spatial container of group continuity.
Solidity and straightness give enacted truth a structural cohesion despite displacement.
Repeated gathering supplies the adversarial group's visible outer unity.
Protection inside a surrounding fort supplies the enclosure that appears to secure that unity.
The inner core relocates the decisive test of unity beneath the gathered exterior.
Dispersion makes the protected group's inner fragmentation explicit.

structural_cues: Plural imperfect verbs coordinate the focus group before the collective demonstrative and pronoun identify them.
In 59:14, the second occurrence of together is immediately reversed by the statement that their hearts are diverse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displaced but jointly acting migrants and fortified people whose hearts are scattered; I infer a cross-group contrast between ethical and spatial cohesion. A live alternative limits 59:14 to an adversary diagnosis without making it illuminate the focus group's unity.

changed_reading.before: Loss of home and wealth records only the migrants' deprivation.
changed_reading.after: Their loss becomes a stress test showing that collective solidity can survive without enclosure or property, while fortified gathering can conceal inner dispersion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates anatomical and material branches rather than asserting the ordinary lexical sense. It remains anchored in the focus's vertebral and back-breaking فقر images, coerced exit, and solid صدق, while 59:21 and 59:23 supply cracking and repair. Render it only as a heuristic analogy, not as a claim that فقير literally means broken-backed here or that الجبار has one exclusive contextual sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins poverty, forced removal from home and wealth, continued aid, and a closing solidity-bearing truth root.

activation_trace.role: Articulated vertebrae supply a bodily image of the structure that holds a person upright.
A back-breaking calamity turns coerced dispossession into a contained image of structural fracture.
Solidity and straightness supply the counter-image of a stance restored through enacted truth.
A gathered solid mass supplies the contextual body capable of being fractured.
A split opening in something solid makes fracture a visible transformation rather than mere disappearance.
Repair of breakage and deficiency supplies a divine horizon of reconstitution after social fracture.

changed_reading.before: Poverty is solely a shortage of external means.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, expulsion breaks a social backbone, while continued seeking, aid, and truth enact an uprightness open to repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because rain and gift are not asserted as the direct lexical meaning of ينصرون in the sentence. It remains anchored in that verb's relief and gift branches, the focus's favor and poverty roots, and 59:7's transfer among hands. Downstream prose should mark it as an image of reciprocity, not replace the ordinary sense of active aid.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same people are marked by material need, seek favor as gift, and immediately become agents of aid.

activation_trace.role: Need positions the migrants first as people who can receive material support.
Favor as gift supplies the incoming side of an exploratory reciprocal flow.
Rain and relief recast their aid as life-giving succor flowing outward despite their need.
Gift makes the dispossessed imaginable as givers rather than fixed endpoints of charity.
Movement between hands supplies the contextual circulation frame for changing recipient and giver roles.

changed_reading.before: The poor are beneficiaries, and their support is a separate duty.
changed_reading.after: In an exploratory reciprocity, recipients of returned wealth become relays of relief, so favor received and aid given form circulation rather than fixed donor-recipient identities.

strongest_changes: The focus's poverty is causally produced by coerced loss, while the migration form retains agency.
The anti-concentration frame in 59:7 turns the migrants from objects of pity into claimants within a redistributive order.
The failed departure-and-aid promises in 59:11-12 make the truthful label an enacted verdict under mirrored tests.
The settled group's costly preference in 59:9 completes displacement with relational rehoming.
summary.what_was_special: Exit, migration, aid, and truth recur in opposed social configurations: dispossession can lead to enacted commitment and reciprocal belonging, while enclosure and verbal alliance can conceal failure and fragmentation. The focus acts as a hinge between property redistribution and community formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise syntactic strength of 59:8's attachment to the allocation statement in 59:7 remains open.
The fracture-and-repair reading is intentionally a branch-induced material analogy, not a lexical substitution.
The circulation image for aid is exploratory and must not displace the ordinary support sense.
